name: Filipino Chicken Tinola with Rice

components.name: Chicken Tinola

ingredients.name: Fresh hot pepper leaves or spinach

steps: Sauté onion, garlic and ginger in oil for 3 minutes without burning.
Add chicken pieces and brown gently for about 5 minutes. Season with black pepper.
Add 1.44 litres water, bring to a simmer, skim surface, and cook gently around 35 to 40 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Add bouillon and chopped green papaya; cook until papaya is almost tender, about 5 to 10 minutes.
Add fish sauce and leafy greens; simmer very briefly until wilted. Chicken must reach 74°C.
Divide rice, soup broth, vegetables and edible meat consistently across five containers; do not leave cooked rice at room temperature.

components.name: Jasmine Rice
steps: Cook jasmine rice in a separate saucepan with 405 ml water; keep covered and rest when finished.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Panlasang Pinoy tinola source is for five servings. UNHANGRY adds dry rice as a complete-meal accompaniment. Bone-in raw chicken yield is variable.
Storing & reheating: Freeze soup without fresh leaves for better texture; stir fresh spinach or malunggay into reheated soup.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
